source_listing: Documented source identity; verify the exact variant before using a manual or package.
source_unavailable: No model-specific matrix linked. Consult the cited sources; no model route has been inferred.
empty_results: No entries match. Try a shorter name or reset the filters.
no_manuals: No manual linked for this entry yet. Consult the source references below; absence here is not proof that a manual does not exist.
metadata_only: Reference metadata only; no original file included. External links require Internet access; current availability is unverified.
document_note: Selected document reference, not a promise of applicability. Check the exact machine type and variant. A product guide, user guide or community reference is not necessarily a service manual.
utilities_note: Readme and reference links only. No diagnostic binaries, installers, recovery images, firmware or manufacturer document bodies are included or executed by this index. A source link is not redistribution permission.
diagnostic_description: Read diagnostic guidance first: confirm the intended model and tool version. A historical readme reference is not a diagnostic executable or a recovery environment.
reference_description: Supporting reference only. Read the original notes and verify applicability before choosing any package or procedure.
sources_intro: The references behind the catalogue, and what they can tell you.
safety_text: Read the package README. Check the exact model, machine type, operating system, architecture and dependencies.
footer: Independent community reference · Not affiliated with IBM or Lenovo
legacy_note: Static HTML is readable without scripts or a server. External manuals and drivers require Internet access. Legacy-browser compatibility has not been verified.
no_drivers: No driver metadata linked for this exact entry yet. Consult the observed source links below; do not infer support from another model in the same family.
no_firmware: No firmware metadata linked for this exact entry.
firmware_warning_text: A wrong BIOS or embedded-controller update can permanently damage the machine. Verify exact model, machine type, existing firmware, power requirements and original instructions. These are source references only, not update recommendations. This index never runs or automatically downloads any package.
availability_note: Current download availability and installation compatibility are unverified. Check the original readme and exact model before any use; a link is not a tested package.
driver_note: Entries are linked by explicit model identifiers from the cited source. Advertised OS names and package titles retain their original designation. No family-wide compatibility is inferred.
missing_download: No download URL recorded; availability unknown.
missing_readme: No readme URL recorded; model applicability unverified.
no_package_links: No download or readme URL recorded. Follow the source listing; availability is unknown.
github_repository: View the project on GitHub (opens in a new tab)
sources_docs_text: Service manuals, model identities and original software listings.
sources_specs_text: Technical specifications and withdrawn product reference books.
sources_wiki_text: Community research, model history and supporting references.
sources_listing_text: The manufacturer lists the package. Its download may no longer be available.
sources_readme_text: The original notes name the model or supported systems. Read the conditions.
sources_compatibility_text: A listing or README is not an installation test. Compatibility remains unverified.
sources_firmware_text: A wrong update can permanently damage the machine. Verify existing firmware and power requirements, and follow the original instructions.
sources_reference_intro: Model identity and dating references. Individual model pages also cite their documents, software and specifications.
sources_method_dates: A regional listing or dated brochure does not establish a worldwide first launch. Exact variants and source qualifications remain on each model page.
sources_method_files: Only factual metadata and links are published, not manufacturer files or copied source pages. External files need Internet access and keep their original licenses.
sources_method_operations: The catalogue never downloads or runs packages automatically. Firmware, recovery, erasure and diagnostics are separate deliberate operations. A source link or hash grants no redistribution rights.
package_filter_note: Filter by the system named in the source, not by tested compatibility. Check the original README and architecture.
package_filter_empty: No software matches these filters. Try another system or reset the filters.
social_home_description: Manuals, driver listings and source-backed references for ThinkPad models. An independent community archive.
social_model_description: {model}: manuals, driver listings, specifications and source references. Check the exact model and package README before installing.
social_sources_description: IBM and Lenovo documentation, PSREF specifications and ThinkWiki references, with evidence levels and coverage notes.
social_year_description: Browse ThinkPad catalogue entries with source-documented dates in {year}, with manuals, software listings and references.
social_unknown_description: ThinkPad catalogue entries with unconfirmed or partially documented introduction dates, with manuals, software listings and source references.
social_image_alt: ThinkPad Archive wordmark on graphite with a red pointing-stick cap. Manuals, software and history.
